description: Read-only, tie-safe managed-dispatch inventory. Optionally filters one exact state and returns up to limit rows ordered by created_at then id. A non-null next_cursor means another page exists; callers must echo both after_created_at and after_id and continue until next_cursor is null before claiming a complete census. Legacy ttl_seconds, expires_at, and expires_at_window_seconds may be null during the F1 compatibility bridge and are returned as null, never coerced to expiry.
embedding_description: Enumerate every durable managed-dispatch row through StateManagementInterface with an explicit created_at/id cursor for complete migration inventory, compatibility review, and legacy reconciliation. Use this bounded read instead of raw SQL, fixed ceilings, or a first-page truncation guess.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: A bounded dispatches page with returned, truncated, and next_cursor fields.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: State the returned count and whether next_cursor is null. Never describe a truncated page as the complete inventory. Preserve nullable legacy TTL fields as null.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads managed_dispatch through StateManagementInterface.query_ordered using the composite created_at/id cursor; no state changes occur.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: page_limit_invalid means limit is outside 1..250. page_cursor_invalid means only one cursor component was supplied. state_service_unavailable means the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use a valid page size and echo both cursor components exactly. Restart from the first page if a cursor was copied incompletely.
